sentences.en: Bismillah hir rahman ir rahim. In the name of God, the most merciful, the most beneficent.
sentences.zh: Bismillah hir rahman ir rahim。以最仁慈、最仁慈的上帝之名。

sentences.en: Your Majesties, Your royal highnesses, distinguished members of the Norweigan Nobel Committee.
sentences.zh: 陛下、殿下、尊敬的挪威诺贝尔委员会成员。

sentences.en: Dear sisters and brothers, today is a day of great happiness for me.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的兄弟姐妹们，今天对我来说是一个非常幸福的日子。

sentences.en: I am humbled that the Nobel Committee has selected me for this precious award.
sentences.zh: 诺贝尔委员会选择我获得这一宝贵奖项，我感到很荣幸。

sentences.en: Thank you to everyone for your continued support and love.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家一直以来的支持和厚爱。

sentences.en: Thank you for the letters and cards that I still receive from all around the world.
sentences.zh: 感谢我仍然收到来自世界各地的信件和卡片。

sentences.en: Your kind and encouraging words strengthen and inspire me.
sentences.zh: 您友善和鼓励的话语使我坚强并受到启发。

sentences.en: I would like to thank my parents for their unconditional love.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢我的父母，感谢他们无条件的爱。

sentences.en: Thank you to my father for not clipping my wings and for letting me fly.
sentences.zh: 感谢我的父亲没有剪掉我的翅膀，让我飞翔。

sentences.en: Thank you to my mother for inspiring me to be patient and to always speak the truth - which we strongly believe is the true message of Islam.
sentences.zh: 感谢我的母亲激励我保持耐心并始终说真话 - 我们坚信这是伊斯兰教的真正信息。

sentences.en: And also thank you to all my wonderful teachers, who inspired me to believe in myself and be brave.
sentences.zh: 还要感谢我所有出色的老师，他们激励我相信自己并勇敢。

sentences.en: I am proud, well, in fact, I am very proud to be the first Pashtun, the first Pakistani, and the youngest person to receive this award.
sentences.zh: 我很自豪，嗯，事实上，我很自豪能够成为第一个普什图人，第一个巴基斯坦人，也是最年轻的获得这个奖项的人。

sentences.en: Along with that, along with that, I am pretty certain that I am also the first recipient
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我很确定我也是第一个接收者

sentences.en: of the Nobel Peace Prize who still fights with her younger brothers.
sentences.zh: 诺贝尔和平奖得主，她仍然和她的弟弟们一起战斗。

sentences.en: I want there to be peace everywhere, but my brothers and I are still working on that.
sentences.zh: 我希望到处都是和平，但我和我的兄弟们仍在为此努力。

sentences.en: I am also honored to receive this award together with Kailash Satyarthi, who has been a champion for children's rights for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我也很荣幸与长期致力于儿童权利捍卫者的 Kailash Satyarthi 一起获得这一奖项。

sentences.en: Twice as long, in fact, than I have been alive.
sentences.zh: 事实上，是我活着的时间的两倍。

sentences.en: I am proud that we can work together, we can work together and show the world that an Indian
sentences.zh: 我很自豪我们可以共同努力，我们可以共同努力向世界展示印度

sentences.en: and a Pakistani, they can work together and achieve their goals of children's rights.
sentences.zh: 和巴基斯坦人，他们可以共同努力，实现儿童权利的目标。

sentences.en: Dear brothers and sisters, I was named after the inspirational Malalai of Maiwand who is
sentences.zh: 亲爱的兄弟姐妹们，我是以鼓舞人心的迈旺德马拉莱（Malalai）的名字命名的，他是

sentences.en: the Pashtun Joan of Arc. The word Malala means grief-stricken", sad", but in order to lend some happiness to it,
sentences.zh: 普什图圣女贞德。马拉拉这个词的意思是“悲伤”、“悲伤”，但为了给它带来一些快乐，

sentences.en: my grandfather would always call me Malala – The happiest girl in the world" and today I am very happy that we are together fighting for an important cause.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父总是叫我马拉拉——世界上最幸福的女孩”，今天我很高兴我们一起为一项重要事业而奋斗。

sentences.en: This award is not just for me. It is for those forgotten children who want an education.
sentences.zh: 这个奖不只属于我一个人。它是为那些想要接受教育的被遗忘的孩子而设计的。

sentences.en: It is for those frightened children who want peace.
sentences.zh: 这是为那些想要和平的受惊的孩子们准备的。

sentences.en: It is for those voiceless children who want change.
sentences.zh: 它是为那些想要改变的无声孩子而准备的。

sentences.en: I am here to stand up for their rights, to raise their voice... it is not time to pity them.
sentences.zh: 我来这里是为了维护他们的权利，提高他们的声音……现在不是怜悯他们的时候。

sentences.en: It is not time to pity them. It is time to take action so it becomes the last time, the last time, so it becomes the
sentences.zh: 现在还不是怜悯他们的时候。是时候采取行动了，所以就变成了最后一次，最后一次，所以就变成了

sentences.en: last time that we see a child deprived of education.
sentences.zh: 上次我们看到一个孩子被剥夺了教育机会。

sentences.en: I have found that people describe me in many different ways.
sentences.zh: 我发现人们用很多不同的方式描述我。

sentences.en: Some people call me the girl who was shot by the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 有人称我为被塔利班枪杀的女孩。

sentences.en: And some, the girl who fought for her rights.
sentences.zh: 还有一些，为自己的权利而战的女孩。

sentences.en: Some people, call me a "Nobel Laureate" now.
sentences.zh: 现在有些人称我为“诺贝尔奖获得者”。

sentences.en: However, my brothers still call me that annoying bossy sister.
sentences.zh: 然而，我的兄弟们仍然叫我那个烦人的专横姐姐。

sentences.en: As far as I know, I am just a committed and even stubborn person who wants to see every
sentences.zh: 据我所知，我只是一个执着甚至固执的人，想看到每一个

sentences.en: child getting a quality education, who wants to see women having equal rights and who wants peace in every corner of the world.
sentences.zh: 儿童接受优质教育，希望看到妇女享有平等权利，希望世界每个角落都有和平。

sentences.en: Education is one of the blessings of life—and one of its necessities.
sentences.zh: 教育是生活的祝福之一，也是生活的必需品之一。

sentences.en: That has been my experience during the 17 years of my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我17年来的经历。

sentences.en: In my paradise home, Swat, I always loved learning and discovering new things.
sentences.zh: 在我的天堂之家斯瓦特，我总是喜欢学习和发现新事物。

sentences.en: I remember when my friends and I would decorate our hands with henna on special occasions.
sentences.zh: 我记得我和我的朋友在特殊场合会用指甲花装饰我们的手。

sentences.en: And instead of drawing flowers and patterns we would paint our hands with mathematical formulas and equations.
sentences.zh: 我们不再画花朵和图案，而是用数学公式和方程来画我们的手。

sentences.en: We had a thirst for education, we had a thirst for education because our future was right there in that classroom.
sentences.zh: 我们渴望教育，我们渴望教育，因为我们的未来就在那间教室里。

sentences.en: We would sit and learn and read together.
sentences.zh: 我们会坐下来一起学习和阅读。

sentences.en: We loved to wear neat and tidy school uniforms and we would sit there with big dreams in our eyes.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢穿着干净整洁的校服，坐在那儿，眼中充满了远大的梦想。

sentences.en: We wanted to make our parents proud and prove that we could also excel in our studies and achieve those goals, which some people think only boys can.
sentences.zh: 我们想让父母感到自豪，并证明我们也可以在学习上取得优异成绩并实现这些目标，有些人认为只有男孩才能做到。

sentences.en: But things did not remain the same. When I was in Swat, which was a place of tourism and beauty, suddenly changed into a place
sentences.zh: 但事情并没有保持原样。当我在斯瓦特时，这个旅游胜地和美景突然变成了一个地方

sentences.en: of terrorism. I was just ten that more than 400 schools were destroyed.
sentences.zh: 恐怖主义。我才十岁，就有 400 多所学校被毁。

sentences.en: Women were flogged. People were killed. And our beautiful dreams turned into nightmares.
sentences.zh: 妇女遭到鞭打。人们被杀了。我们美好的梦想变成了噩梦。

sentences.en: Education went from being a right to being a crime.
sentences.zh: 教育从一项权利变成了一种犯罪。

sentences.en: Girls were stopped from going to school.
sentences.zh: 女孩们被禁止上学。

sentences.en: When my world suddenly changed, my priorities changed too.
sentences.zh: 当我的世界突然改变时，我的优先事项也改变了。

sentences.en: I had two options. One was to remain silent and wait to be killed.
sentences.zh: 我有两个选择。一是保持沉默，等待被杀。

sentences.en: And the second was to speak up and then be killed.
sentences.zh: 第二个是说出来然后被杀。

sentences.en: I chose the second one. I decided to speak up.
sentences.zh: 我选择了第二个。我决定说出来。

sentences.en: We could not just stand by and see those injustices of the terrorists denying our rights, ruthlessly killing people and misusing the name of Islam.
sentences.zh: 我们不能袖手旁观，眼睁睁地看着恐怖分子剥夺我们的权利、残酷杀害人民、滥用伊斯兰教的名义的不公正行为。

sentences.en: We decided to raise our voice and tell them: Have you not learned, have you not learned that in the Holy Quran Allah says: if you kill one person it is as if you kill the whole
sentences.zh: 我们决定提高声音告诉他们：你们难道没有听说过吗？你们难道没有听说过，在《古兰经》中真主说：如果你杀了一个人，就等于你杀了整个人。

sentences.en: humanity? Do you not know that Mohammad, peace be upon him, the prophet of mercy, he says, do not harm yourself or others".
sentences.zh: 人性？你难道不知道穆罕默德，愿他安息，这位仁慈的先知说，不要伤害自己或他人”。

sentences.en: And do you not know that the very first word of the Holy Quran is the word Iqra", which means read"?
sentences.zh: 难道你不知道《古兰经》的第一个词是“伊克拉”，意思是“读”吗？

sentences.en: The terrorists tried to stop us and attacked me and my friends who are here today, on our school bus in 2012, but neither their ideas nor their bullets could win.
sentences.zh: 2012 年，恐怖分子试图阻止我们，并在我们的校车上袭击了今天在这里的我和我的朋友，但他们的想法和子弹都无法获胜。

sentences.en: We survived. And since that day, our voices have grown louder and louder.
sentences.zh: 我们活了下来。从那天起，我们的声音越来越大。

sentences.en: I tell my story, not because it is unique, but because it is not.
sentences.zh: 我讲述我的故事，不是因为它独特，而是因为它不是。

sentences.en: It is the story of many girls. Today, I tell their stories too.
sentences.zh: 这是很多女孩的故事。今天我也讲讲他们的故事。

sentences.en: I have brought with me some of my sisters from Pakistan, from Nigeria and from Syria, who share this story.
sentences.zh: 我带来了一些来自巴基斯坦、尼日利亚和叙利亚的姐妹，她们分享了这个故事。

sentences.en: My brave sisters Shazia and Kainat who were also shot that day on our school bus.
sentences.zh: 我勇敢的姐妹莎齐亚和凯纳特那天也在我们的校车上被枪杀。

sentences.en: But they have not stopped learning. And my brave sister Kainat Soomro who went through severe abuse and extreme violence,
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有停止学习。还有我勇敢的妹妹 Kainat Soomro，她经历了严重的虐待和极端的暴力，

sentences.en: even her brother was killed, but she did not succumb.
sentences.zh: 连她的哥哥都被杀了，但她没有屈服。

sentences.en: Also my sisters here, whom I have met during my Malala Fund campaign.
sentences.zh: 还有我在马拉拉基金会竞选期间认识的姐妹们。

sentences.en: My 16-year-old courageous sister, Mezon from Syria, who now lives in Jordan as a refugee and goes from tent to tent encouraging girls and boys to learn.
sentences.zh: 我 16 岁的勇敢妹妹 Mezon 来自叙利亚，现在作为难民住在约旦，她从一个帐篷到另一个帐篷鼓励女孩和男孩学习。

sentences.en: And my sister Amina, from the North of Nigeria, where Boko Haram threatens, and stops girls and even kidnaps girls, just for wanting to go to school.
sentences.zh: 我的妹妹阿米娜来自尼日利亚北部，那里的女孩受到博科圣地的威胁、阻止，甚至绑架女孩，只是因为她们想要上学。

sentences.en: Though I appear as one girl, though I appear as one girl, one person, who is 5 foot 2 inches tall if you include my high heels.
sentences.zh: 虽然我表现为一个女孩，尽管我表现为一个女孩，一个人，如果算上我的高跟鞋的话，她有 5 英尺 2 英寸高。

sentences.en: (It means I am 5 foot only) I am not a lone voice, I am not a lone voice, I am many.
sentences.zh: （这意味着我只有 5 英尺）我不是一个孤独的声音，我不是一个孤独的声音，我有很多。

sentences.en: I am Malala. But I am also Shazia. I am Kainat.
sentences.zh: 我是马拉拉。但我也是莎齐亚。我是凯纳特。

sentences.en: I am Kainat Soomro. I am Mezon. I am Amina.
sentences.zh: 我是凯纳特·苏姆罗。我是梅松。我是阿米娜。

sentences.en: I am those 66 million girls who are deprived of education.
sentences.zh: 我就是那六千六百万被剥夺教育机会的女孩。

sentences.en: And today I am not raising my voice, it is the voice of those 66 million girls.
sentences.zh: 今天我发出的不是我的声音，而是那六千六百万女孩的声音。

sentences.en: Sometimes people like to ask me why should girls go to school, why is it important to
sentences.zh: 有时人们喜欢问我为什么女孩应该上学，为什么上学很重要

sentences.en: them. But I think the more important question is why shouldn't they, why shouldn't they have this right to go to school.
sentences.zh: 他们。但我认为更重要的问题是他们为什么不应该，为什么他们不应该有这个上学的权利。

sentences.en: Dear sisters and brothers, today, in half of the world, we see rapid progress and development.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的兄弟姐妹们，今天，在半个地球上，我们看到了日新月异的进步和发展。

sentences.en: However, there are many countries where millions still suffer from the very old problems of war, poverty, and injustice.
sentences.zh: 然而，在许多国家，数百万人仍然遭受着战争、贫困和不公正等老问题的困扰。

sentences.en: We still see conflicts in which innocent people lose their lives and children become orphans.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然看到无辜者丧生、儿童成为孤儿的冲突。

sentences.en: We see many people becoming refugees in Syria, Gaza, and Iraq.
sentences.zh: 我们看到许多人在叙利亚、加沙和伊拉克成为难民。

sentences.en: In Afghanistan, we see families being killed in suicide attacks and bomb blasts.
sentences.zh: 在阿富汗，我们看到许多家庭在自杀式袭击和炸弹爆炸中丧生。

sentences.en: Many children in Africa do not have access to education because of poverty.
sentences.zh: 非洲的许多儿童因贫困而无法接受教育。

sentences.en: And as I said, we still see, we still see girls who have no freedom to go to school in the north of Nigeria.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我们仍然看到，我们仍然看到尼日利亚北部的女孩没有上学的自由。

sentences.en: Many children in countries like Pakistan and India, as Kailash Satyarthi mentioned, many children, especially in India and Pakistan are deprived of their right to education because
sentences.zh: 正如凯拉什·萨蒂亚蒂提到的，巴基斯坦和印度等国家的许多儿童，特别是印度和巴基斯坦的许多儿童被剥夺了受教育的权利，因为

sentences.en: of social taboos, or they have been forced into child marriage or into child labor.
sentences.zh: 社会禁忌，或者他们被迫童婚或童工。

sentences.en: One of my very good school friends, the same age as me, who had always been a bold and confident girl, dreamed of becoming a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我的一个非常好的同学，与我同龄，一直是一个大胆而自信的女孩，梦想成为一名医生。

sentences.en: But her dream remained a dream. At the age of 12, she was forced to get married.
sentences.zh: 但她的梦想仍然是一个梦想。 12岁时，她被迫结婚。

sentences.en: And then soon she had a son, she had a child when she herself was still a child – only 14.
sentences.zh: 然后很快她就有了一个儿子，当她自己还是个孩子的时候她就生了一个孩子——只有 14 岁。

sentences.en: I know that she could have been a very good doctor.
sentences.zh: 我知道她本可以成为一名非常好的医生。

sentences.en: But she couldn't ... because she was a girl.
sentences.zh: 但她不能……因为她是个女孩。

sentences.en: Her story is why I dedicate the Nobel Peace Prize money to the Malala Fund, to help give girls quality education, everywhere, anywhere in the world and to raise their voices.
sentences.zh: 她的故事就是我将诺贝尔和平奖奖金捐献给马拉拉基金的原因，以帮助为世界各地的女孩提供优质教育并提高她们的声音。

sentences.en: The first place this funding will go to is where my heart is, to build schools in Pakistan—especially in my home of Swat and Shangla.
sentences.zh: 这笔资金的第一个用途就是我的心所在，在巴基斯坦建造学校，特别是在我的家乡斯瓦特和香拉。

sentences.en: In my own village, there is still no secondary school for girls.
sentences.zh: 在我自己的村庄里，仍然没有女子中学。

sentences.en: And it is my wish and my commitment, and now my challenge to build one so that my friends and my sisters can go there to school and get a quality education and to get this opportunity
sentences.zh: 这是我的愿望和承诺，现在我的挑战是建立一个这样的学校，以便我的朋友和姐妹们可以去那里上学，接受优质教育，并获得这个机会

sentences.en: to fulfill their dreams. This is where I will begin, but it is not where I will stop.
sentences.zh: 实现他们的梦想。这是我要开始的地方，但不是我要停止的地方。

sentences.en: I will continue this fight until I see every child, every child in school.
sentences.zh: 我将继续这场斗争，直到我看到每个孩子，每个在学校的孩子。

sentences.en: Dear brothers and sisters, great people, who brought change, like Martin Luther King and Nelson Mandela, Mother Teresa and Aung San Suu Kyi, once stood here on this stage.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的兄弟姐妹们，马丁·路德·金、纳尔逊·曼德拉、特蕾莎修女、昂山素季等带来变革的伟大人物，都曾经站在这个舞台上。

sentences.en: I hope the steps that Kailash Satyarthi and I have taken so far and will take on this journey will also bring change – lasting change.
sentences.zh: 我希望凯拉什·萨蒂亚尔蒂和我迄今为止所采取的以及将在这一旅程中采取的步骤也能带来改变——持久的改变。

sentences.en: My great hope is that this will be the last time, this will be the last time we must fight for education.
sentences.zh: 我最大的希望是，这将是最后一次，这将是我们必须为教育而奋斗的最后一次。

sentences.en: Let's solve this once and for all. We have already taken many steps.
sentences.zh: 让我们一劳永逸地解决这个问题。我们已经采取了许多步骤。

sentences.en: Now it is time to take a leap. It is not time to tell the world leaders to realize how important education is - they
sentences.zh: 现在是时候迈出一步了。现在还不是告诉世界领导人认识到教育有多么重要的时候 - 他们

sentences.en: already know it - their own children are in good schools.
sentences.zh: 已经知道了——他们自己的孩子都在好学校。

sentences.en: Now it is time to call them to take action for the rest of the world's children.
sentences.zh: 现在是时候呼吁他们为世界其他地区的儿童采取行动了。

sentences.en: We ask the world leaders to unite and make education their top priority.
sentences.zh: 我们要求世界领导人团结起来，把教育作为首要任务。

sentences.en: Fifteen years ago, the world leaders decided on a set of global goals, the Millennium Development Goals.
sentences.zh: 十五年前，世界领导人决定了一套全球目标，即千年发展目标。

sentences.en: In the years that have followed, we have seen some progress.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，我们看到了一些进展。

sentences.en: The number of children out of school has been halved, as Kailash Satyarthi said.
sentences.zh: 正如凯拉什·萨蒂亚蒂所说，失学儿童人数已减少一半。

sentences.en: However, the world focused only on primary education, and progress did not reach everyone.
sentences.zh: 然而，世界只关注初等教育，进步并没有惠及所有人。

sentences.en: In the year 2015, representatives from all around the world will meet in the United Nations to set the next set of goals, the Sustainable Development Goals.
sentences.zh: 2015年，来自世界各地的代表将齐聚联合国，制定下一组目标——可持续发展目标。

sentences.en: This will set the world's ambition for the next generations.
sentences.zh: 这将为下一代设定世界的雄心。

sentences.en: The world can no longer accept, the world can no longer accept that basic education is enough.
sentences.zh: 世界不能再接受，世界不能再接受基础教育就足够了。

sentences.en: Why do leaders accept that for children in developing countries, only basic literacy is sufficient, when their own children do homework in Algebra, Mathematics, Science,
sentences.zh: 为什么领导人会认为，对于发展中国家的孩子来说，只要具备基本的识字能力就足够了，而他们自己的孩子却要做代数、数学、科学、

sentences.en: and Physics? Leaders must seize this opportunity to guarantee a free, quality, primary and secondary education
sentences.zh: 和物理？领导人必须抓住这个机会，保证免费、优质的中小学教育

sentences.en: for every child.
sentences.zh: 对于每个孩子。

sentences.en: Some will say this is impractical, or too expensive, or too hard.
sentences.zh: 有些人会说这是不切实际的，或者太昂贵，或者太难。

sentences.en: Or maybe even impossible. But it is time the world thinks bigger.
sentences.zh: 或者甚至是不可能的。但现在是世界思考更大的时候了。

sentences.en: Dear sisters and brothers, the so-called world of adults may understand it, but we children don't.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的兄弟姐妹们，所谓大人的世界也许懂，但我们小孩子却不懂。

sentences.en: Why is it that countries which we call strong" are so powerful in creating wars but are so
sentences.zh: 为什么我们所谓的“强国”制造战争的能力那么强，但实际上却如此？

sentences.en: weak in bringing peace? Why is it that giving guns is so easy but giving books is so hard?
sentences.zh: 带来和平的能力弱吗？为什么送枪容易，送书却这么难？

sentences.en: Why is it, why is it that making tanks is so easy, but building schools are so hard?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢，为什么造坦克那么容易，建学校那么难呢？

sentences.en: We are living in the modern age and we believe that nothing is impossible.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在现代，我们相信没有什么是不可能的。

sentences.en: We have reached the moon 45 years ago and maybe will soon land on Mars.
sentences.zh: 45 年前我们已经登上月球，也许很快就会登陆火星。

sentences.en: Then, in this 21st century, we must be able to give every child quality education.
sentences.zh: 那么，在21世纪，我们必须能够给每一个孩子提供优质的教育。

sentences.en: Dear sisters and brothers, dear fellow children, we must work... not wait.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的兄弟姐妹、亲爱的孩子们，我们必须工作……而不是等待。

sentences.en: Not just the politicians and the world leaders, we all need to contribute.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是政治家和世界领导人，我们都需要做出贡献。

sentences.en: Me. You. We. It is our duty. Let us become the first generation to decide to be the last, let us become the first generation
sentences.zh: 我。你。我们。这是我们的责任。让我们成为第一代决定成为最后一代，让我们成为第一代

sentences.en: that decides to be the last that sees empty classrooms, lost childhoods, and wasted potentials.
sentences.zh: 决定成为最后一个看到空荡荡的教室、失去的童年和浪费的潜力的人。

sentences.en: Let this be the last time that a girl or a boy spend their childhood in a factory.
sentences.zh: 让这成为女孩或男孩最后一次在工厂度过童年。

sentences.en: Let this be the last time that a girl is forced into early child marriage.
sentences.zh: 让这是女孩最后一次被迫早婚。

sentences.en: Let this be the last time that a child loses life in war.
sentences.zh: 让这是最后一次儿童在战争中丧生。

sentences.en: Let this be the last time that we see a child out of school.
sentences.zh: 让这是我们最后一次看到孩子失学。

sentences.en: Let this end with us. Let's begin this ending ... together ... today ... right here, right now.
sentences.zh: 让我们一起结束这一切吧。让我们一起开始这个结局……今天……就在这里，就在此时。

sentences.en: Let's begin this ending now. Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 现在就让我们开始这个结局吧。太感谢了。
